name: Hayyan Ali
biography: Hayyan Ali brings over a decade of expertise in mobile communication, radio planning, and optimization to the forefront of cutting-edge technological advancements. Currently pursuing a Ph.D. at the Czech Technical University in Prague, Hayyan's research focuses on the integration of Machine Learning within mobile networks' radio interfaces. In addition to his academic pursuits, Hayyan serves as a Security Delivery Senior Analyst at Accenture, where he spearheads initiatives to fortify mobile communication infrastructures. Leveraging his extensive knowledge, he specializes in detecting vulnerabilities within radio interface protocols, conducting penetration testing on wireless interfaces in IoT devices, and deploying Machine Learning algorithms to automate pen testing processes.
